product.name: Aerobex FlexBand 12
product.description: The Aerobex FlexBand 12 is a versatile resistance band designed for home and gym workouts. Each band measures 120 cm in length and is constructed from a blend of nylon and natural rubber, offering a smooth feel and durable performance. The band comes in a vibrant red color and is available in a single tension level suitable for strength training, rehabilitation, and mobility drills. Users can integrate the FlexBand 12 into body‑weight routines, crossfit circuits, or as an accessory for kettlebell and dumbbell exercises. The product includes a clear instruction guide and a storage pouch for easy transport.
